0.original: Qhoterl Pasol wants to bring a touch of style to some otherwise drab textiles.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

1.original: Deliver the requested items to Qhoterl Pasol.

48.original: We Qitari are experts at weaving clothes, bags, and so on, which we decorate in the traditional manner using various colors.

49.original: But with so many of us preoccupied with excavating the caves, we've had little time to gather the raw ingredients for producing the dyes we need.

50.original: Were an altruistic volunteer to bring me a small quantity of purple pigment, I think a reward of some sort would be in order.

51.original: Were an altruistic volunteer to bring me a small quantity of turmeric, I think a reward of some sort would be in order.

52.original: Were an altruistic volunteer to bring me a spiralshell, I think a reward of some sort would be in order. And were said volunteer to use fruit worms as bait, I'm sure they'd snag one in a jiffy!

53.original: The Blind Forest of Yx'Maja would be an excellent place to begin your search, but watch out for beasties, especially those tarichuks. Oh, I can't stand them!

54.original: The Blind Forest of Yx'Maja would be an excellent place to begin your search, but watch out for beasties, especially those tarichuks. Oh, I can't stand them!

55.original: The southern part of Mjrl's Regret is where you're most likely to find one, but don't let those caracals catch you by surprise!

56.original: Do you have something for me, by any chance? I'm <hex:021A020203>dye<hex:021A020103>-ing to see it! <snort>

58.original: With this, we'll be able to bring a touch of Ronkan elegance to our textiles. The patterns with which we adorn ourselves come from their ancient culture, you see.

59.original: Those that feature a pair of straight, parallel lines represent harmony, whereas spirals are a symbol of the never-ending cycle of nature, for example.

60.original: Perhaps you would consider wearing some of our traditional garments yourself? I think you'd look rather fetching in one of our hats!
